To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a method to study the formation of the DCC in heavy ion collisions using a wavelet transformation and we have shown that the wavelet power spectra of the DCC are scale-dependent.
the wavelet power spectra of a disoriented condensate exhibit a strong dependence of the scale while an equilibrating system and standard dynamical models have a flat spectrum.
the wavelet power spectra of a DCC are scale dependent and the scale dependence is a function of the size of the DCC domain.

the study of a disoriented pion condensate (a disoriented chiral phase) in relativistic heavy-ion collisions.
a novel approach to studying the formation of the DCC in high-energy heavy-ion collisions.
the study of the chiral phase transition of the QCD vacuum in the framework of a chiral quark model.
